list: Official PlayStation 5 list: 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden. Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them; guides in our own words, every step cited.

trophies.guide: The platinum is the last trophy you earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are all checked off, so the whole guide below is the route to it. [1][11]
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

steps.t: Treat this as a checklist, not a trophy to chase directly: finish the story, the quest chains, the activities and the 100% cleanup in roadmap order — budget around 200 hours, or 250–300 by the longest estimate. [1][11][14]
Almost nobody holds it yet: Exophase records the platinum at a 0.03% earn rate, the rarest trophy on the list. [6]

trophies.guide: The opening mission. You cannot miss it: finish Gone Fishing and the trophy pops as the story starts. [1][5]
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

steps.t: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to its end; the trophy pops with the mission complete screen. [1][5]
It is the most-earned trophy on the list at a 99.99% earn rate on Exophase, so if it has not popped, the mission itself is unfinished. [6]

trophies.guide: Finish every Chapter 1 story mission. The chapter closes with the mission Paradise Lost, and the trophy pops right after it. [1][5]
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

steps.t: Play through Chapter 1 in story order; the trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends. [1][5]
Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation as Lucia: it raises the meditation counter and the spot vanishes with the chapter. [1]
Keep a manual save from Chapter 1 until the meditation trophy pops, in case the balcony turn out to be required after all. [1]

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. The chapter trophy pops as the next chapter begins, right after the Welcome to Vice City story beat. [1][7]
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

steps.t: Play the Chapter 2 missions in order; the trophy pops as Chapter 3 starts after Welcome to Vice City. [1][7]
Before the chapter ends, clear the optional Chapter 2 finale: it needs the chapter's other jobs done plus at least $15,000. [15]
Use Chapter 2 to unlock the systems the rest of the guide needs: fishing, the Scooter Bros app and the first garage. [1]

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. The trophy pops after the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life, close the chapter out. [1][7]
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

steps.t: Play the Chapter 3 missions in order, then the first two missions of the next chapter, Ocean Beach and Another Life; the trophy pops after them. [1][7]
Chapter 3 is where the quest givers open up: Andy calls Lucia, Randy's Key Cloner arrives, and the jewelry jobs unlock. [1]
Do the Yago street race the moment its hourglass icon appears in this chapter; waiting can lock Yago's missions out. [1]

trophies.guide: Finish the chapter's missions. Sources disagree on whether the final mission sits in this chapter or the next, so this guide never pins the finale to one chapter number. [1][7]
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

steps.t: Play the chapter's missions in order; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. [1]
GTABase places the finale in the following chapter instead, so expect the chapter pop and the finale pop to land close together, in either order. [7]
Keep the story moving before the long cleanup: the finale missions gate nothing for the collectibles, but they gate the last character finales. [18]

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission, Starting From Zero. One source numbers it in Chapter 4 and another in Chapter 5, so this guide calls it only the final mission. [1][7]
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.t: Play the final mission Starting From Zero to its end; the gold pops with the credits. [1]
GTABase names the finale Operation Savage Glory instead and numbers it a chapter later, so do not be surprised if the mission name on screen differs from one guide's label. [7]
Other lists also call the finale Chapter 5, which is why this guide never writes one chapter number for it as a fact. [12]

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a plain story beat: play it through and the trophy pops at the end. [1][5]
trophies.name: Trust

steps.t: Play Breakfast Run in story order; the trophy pops when the mission completes. [1][5]
Story missions like this one are never missable: they stay available until played. [18]

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. Play it through in story order and the trophy pops at the mission complete screen. [1][5]
trophies.name: Break the Bank

steps.t: Play The Cartel Heist in story order; the trophy pops when the mission completes. [1][5]
Story missions like this one are never missable: they stay available until played. [18]

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. A plain story beat: play it through and the trophy pops at the end. [1][5]
trophies.name: Family Matters

steps.t: Play Child's Play in story order; the trophy pops when the mission completes. [1][5]
Story missions like this one are never missable: they stay available until played. [18]

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. Play it through in story order and the trophy pops at the mission complete screen. [1][5]
trophies.name: DWNFALL

steps.t: Play Headliners in story order; the trophy pops when the mission completes. [1][5]
Story missions like this one are never missable: they stay available until played. [18]

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown. A plain story beat at the airport: play it through and the trophy pops at the end. [1][5]
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

steps.t: Play VCIA Takedown in story order; the trophy pops when the mission completes. [1][5]
Story missions like this one are never missable: they stay available until played. [18]

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. One source treats this as the finale and numbers it a chapter later than the other, so this guide never pins the finale to one chapter. [7][1]
trophies.name: Snow Storm

steps.t: Play Operation Savage Glory in story order; the trophy pops when the mission completes. [7]
GTABase numbers this mission in Chapter 5, while other lists call the finale Chapter 5 under a different mission name — the numbering itself is disputed. [7][12]
Do not let the chapter-number dispute slow you down: the mission is a story beat and it stays available until played. [1]

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the completion checklist. This is the long tail of the platinum: every robbery line, every collection line and most of the activities below, but only 15 of 18 meditations. [3][7]
trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.t: Clear the robbery lines first: 22 of 22 Bank Jobs (14 small + 8 vault), 7 of 7 Payday Loans, 34 of 35 Smash 'N' Grabs and 50 of 91 Stick Ups. [15][16]
Fence the totals: $250,000 in marked bills, $200,000 in vehicles, $100,000 in jewelry and $100,000 in narcotics. [15]
Sweep the world lines: 100 of 125 Flamingos, 70 of 79 Discovered Styles, 33 of 33 Underwater Discoveries and 30 of 34 Magazines, Books and Comics. [15]
Finish the small lines: 5 of 7 Kenton Sets, 2 of 2 Playlists, 90 of 100 Basketball Hoops, 5 of 7 Pool games, 4 of 4 Video Games, 2 of 3 Mini Golf courses and 50 of 66 weapons. [15]
Meditation needs only 15 of 18 for 100%, so three spots can be skipped here — but the meditation trophy itself still needs all 18. [1][7]
A second checklist agrees on the shape but not every number: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK locations. [7]
Track it all in game under Progress, and cross-check against the PowerPyx and eGamers 100% checklists when a line looks stuck. [3][13]
Turn on every progress and collection notification in Settings first, so optional missions are never offered and missed silently. [8]
FullSweep's 100% explainer lists the same 35 checklist lines; use it as the tie-breaker when two guides give different totals. [16]

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts of any kind. The world holds 397 in total, so you can skip the awkward third and still finish with room to spare. [1]
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

steps.t: Count the pool before you start: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps, 397 in total. [1]
Farm under-bridge passes first; they are the fastest stunts to repeat and the most numerous. [1]
Track progress under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and press R3 for the per-region breakdown. [1]
Open Map, then Exploration, then Stunt Spots to see every stunt you have found and finished, each with its own name. [1]
You only need 250 of 397, so skip any stunt that fights you and move to the next bridge or jump. [1]
A Long Road needs 300 stunts, so keep going past this trophy if 100% is the goal. [7]

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once each. None needs a win or a score — one try of each is enough, and the game tracks them for you. [1][7]
trophies.name: Master of None

steps.t: Work the list of 9: Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Ranges, Pool, Basketball, Playing a Video Game, a car race or race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. [1][7]
Basketball counts with a single basket scored, so it is the quickest of the nine. [1]
Playing a Video Game means sitting down at any of the four arcade or TV games, not finishing one. [1]
Any race counts for the racing slot: a street race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race. [1]
Check what is left under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities, and clear the missing types one by one. [1]

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two ranges: 18 golds at Griffin and 24 at Rodgers Ranch. Sources disagree on whether that is 12 or 14 courses, but they agree on 42 golds. [1][7]
trophies.name: The Shootist

steps.t: Work the two ranges: Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero and Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn. [1][7]
The agreed split is 18 golds at Griffin and 24 at Rodgers Ranch, 42 in total. [1][12]
Most challenges have 3 difficulty tiers to gold, so expect three gold runs per challenge, not one. [14]
Some challenges stay locked until their requirement is met; they appear on the map once they open. [14]
Track everything under Touch Pad, then Activities, then Shooting Ranges. [14]
Range time also raises your Focus level, which helps the Gunslinger trophy later. [7]

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location holds 3 time trials, and 100% completion needs all 42 of them. [14][7]
trophies.name: Top Fun

steps.t: There are 14 Top Fun locations; win one drone race at each. [14][7]
Some locations charge an entry fee, so carry cash before you fly out to a new one. [14]
Track them under Touch Pad, then Activities, then Drones, then Top Fun Drones. [14]
For 100% you need all 42 drone time trials, 3 per location, so keep racing past the trophy if the platinum is the goal. [14][7]

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeating a race you already won does not count, so keep moving to fresh starting lines. [7][14]
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

steps.t: There are 40 races on offer; you need 20 different wins. [7][14]
Winning the same race twice counts once, so mark each win and move on. [7]
Most race locations let you rent a car on the spot, so a weak garage is no excuse. [7]
Car Rating matters: raise it at Mod Shops before you chase the harder wins. [7][14]

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Meet him after the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, then fish the spot he marks for you. [1][14]
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal); Cal then texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon. [1]
Cal asks for a Parrotfish over 2 kg, so fish his marked spot until one that size bites. [14]
It is the most-earned non-story trophy on Exophase at 1.89%, so the challenge is short once the spot is marked. [6]

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game all the way through. Four games count, and finishing all levels once is enough — the side challenges are optional. [1]
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

steps.t: Four games count: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. [1]
Time Jackers Rewind plays on the TV at home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck runs on an arcade machine. [1]
Finishing means clearing every level once; the in-game challenges are not required, and Exophase puts this at a 0.41% earn rate. [1][6]

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's five-quest chain and its final mission. Andy is Lucia-only, starts in Chapter 3, and her chain is about the Cellerica cult. [1]
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

steps.t: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3; Andy reaches out by call and text with an address in Belville. [1]

Work the five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (the Cellerica Initiation), Read the Label (retrieving the Cellerica Van) and Puff Puff Pass (meeting at the Warehouse). [1]
Finish the chain's final mission and the trophy pops. [1]
Andy's chain does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, so do not expect it to move that counter. [1]

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's chain and its final mission, Maritime Disputes. Start it in Chapter 1, dig up his seven shipwreck treasures with the metal detector, and mind that he vanishes for a while after Chapter 1. [1][14]
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

steps.t: Start in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams (Work for Kenton); look for the green KR icon at Key Lento. [1]
Dig up the 7 shipwreck treasures with the metal detector; the detector is how each one is found. [1]
Track the chain under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees, and the treasures under Progress, then Collections, then Kenton's Treasures. [1]
If Kenton disappears after Chapter 1, do not panic: he returns in Chapters 2 and 3, and calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds his return. [1]

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's five-quest chain and its final mission, Hometown Heroes. It opens after the Chapter 2 Coffee Break at the Thrillbilly Mudclub. [1][14]
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

steps.t: Start after the Chapter 2 Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. [1]
Work the five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (stealing the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes. [1]
Hometown Heroes is both the last quest and the finale: finish it and the trophy pops. [1]
Billy's chain does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, so do not expect it to move that counter. [1]

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Only four strands are confirmed as counting — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete — and the Yago race is time-sensitive, so this is the guide's one possibly missable trophy. [1][15]
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

steps.t: Count only the confirmed strands: Kirk (3 quests), Kyle (3 quests), Yago (4 quests) and Pilot Pete (5 quests). [1]
Do not count Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy or Eddie: PowerPyx confirms none of them move this counter. [1]
Expect the total to pass 8 anyway: PowerPyx notes strangers still undiscovered, so new strands may surface. [1]
Do Yago's Race Against Yago the moment its hourglass icon appears in Chapter 3; skipping it can lock Yago's missions out, and saving first is the safe play. [1][15][10]
Yago's four quests are: Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper (Jason-only), Race Against Yago (time-sensitive) and Brother to Brother (Jason-only). [1]
The game never tells you which strand counted, so check the trophy counter after each strand finishes. [1]
If a strand stalls, check the PowerPyx Strangers & Freaks list for the quest order before assuming it is bugged. [4]

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's chain by delivering his 16-car wishlist. You need the Key Cloner from Chapter 3, and the cars pay more in good condition. [1]
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

steps.t: Get the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs; without it the wishlist cars cannot be taken. [1]
Work the 16-car wishlist: Zorrusso, Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee and Baller ST-D. [1]
Track the list under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List, and watch for the green RK icon west of Vice City. [1]
Hunt the cars around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, deliver them in good condition, and the better the condition the better the pay. [1]

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's chain: shut down the Synthetic Labs. Tyrone is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. [1]
trophies.name: Spin On This!

steps.t: Play as Jason after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, and follow the purple Synthetic Labs marker in Vice City. [1]
Take out the lab in the Take Out Kitty Litter step, then run the Spin On This quest to shut the labs down. [1]
Finish the chain's final mission and the trophy pops; the chain does not count toward Strangers & Freaks. [1]

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots. Ten named spots hold them: eight count twice (once per protagonist), the Chapter 1 balcony counts once and the Ascent counts once — 8 x 2 + 1 + 1 = 18. [15][1]
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

steps.t: Spot 1, Jason's House (meditation 1): meditate at home to open the counter. [1][2]
Spots 2 to 3, Smooth Sand (2–3): the sandbar west of Capri in Mariana County. [1][2]
Spots 4 to 5, Swamp (4–5): the wooden dock near the tower in Buckskin Swamp. [1][2]
Spots 6 to 7, Worn Stone (6–7): the Emerald River bank at Camp Moonflower. [1][2]
Spots 8 to 9, Red Rocks (8–9): Manifest Canyon, where the railway cuts the highway. [1][2]
Spots 10 to 11, Water Wheel (10–11): the broken paper-mill water wheel south of Moreau in Lummox County. [1][2]
Spots 12 to 13, Jutting Cliff (12–13): the tower facing the mine in Mount Kalaga National Park. [1][2]
Spots 14 to 17, Waterfall (14–15) in north-west Tallaloko and Seaside (16–17) on the rock outcrop east of Waning Sands in Leonard County. [1][2]
Spot 18, Ascent Mountain: the stone circle on the Mount Kalaga summit. It only appears once every other meditation is done, with a popup notification. [1][2]

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret Vogel. Bret is Jason-only, opens after the Chapter 2 Coffee Break, and the exact trophy animal is still unconfirmed — hunt his marked targets and keep the carcasses pristine. [1]
trophies.name: Fair Game

steps.t: Play as Jason after the Chapter 2 Coffee Break; Bret's text marks Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret) in Lummox County. Lucia never receives the message. [1]
Pick up the unique rifle Killtelligence SM-69 from the Ammu-Nation weapon locker before you hunt. [1]
Take clean one-shots: a clean kill keeps the carcass pristine and pays more, though it is not required for the trophy. [1]
Bret's 15 Target Decks are all needed for 100%, so clear them even though the trophy animal itself is still unconfirmed. [1]

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards come from packs and the world; selling a card to a pawn shop does not remove it from your collection. [1][14]
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

steps.t: Collect cards until 3 full sets are complete; packs and world pickups are the two sources. [1][14]
Sell spare cards to the pawn shop freely: a sold card stays counted in your Collections progress. [14]
A Long Road needs more than this trophy: 15 of 18 card sets, which takes at least 372 cards if you skip the biggest set. [15]
Track sets under Progress, then Collections, and chase the smallest sets first for the fastest three. [3]

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations: 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities and 23 Sculptures plus the No Flusher Tags. Scanning is enough — you never need to do anything else at a spot. [1][14]
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

steps.t: The pool is 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities and 23 Sculptures plus No Flusher Tags; you need any 100 of them. [1][14]
Scan by holding Up to use WAiNK instantly, then R1 to scan the spot. [1]
Track progress under Touch Pad, then Progress, then Collections, then WAiNK Locations. [1]
A Long Road also needs 100 WAiNK locations, so this trophy and the 100% line finish together. [7]

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. The game holds 80, so you can skip the thirty hardest and still finish with room to spare. [1]
trophies.name: One Last Thing

steps.t: There are 80 challenges in total and the trophy needs 50, ten fewer than the full set. [1]
Track them under Progress, then Challenges; a challenge shows Completed at the bottom right when you scroll over it. [1]
Clear the easy fifty first and leave the grindy ones for the 100% push, which needs 70 of 80. [1]

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the red heat zone. The earliest chance comes right after the Chapter 2 Coffee Break. [1]
trophies.name: Hot Together

steps.t: Wait until after the Chapter 2 Coffee Break, then call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. [1]
Build a 4-star wanted level together, then escape on a fast sports bike. [1]
Head for the train tunnel north of Ambrosia and keep going until you leave the red heat zone; the trophy pops on exit, not in the blinking search area. [1]

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing the wanted level. Keep the level blinking red and blue — if it drops to nothing, or jumps to a red heat zone, the chain fails. [1][9]
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

steps.t: Wait until after the Chapter 2 Coffee Break, and bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and Zombix or Adrenaline. [1]
Work the 3 jewelry shops north of Vice City, open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs; rob several items per shop, ideally the backroom safe with sticky bombs. [1]
Keep the wanted level blinking red and blue between shops, never a solid red heat zone and never nothing at all. [1]
If you leave the first shop before the police arrive, expect to need a fourth shop; the pop lands about 30 seconds after you leave the third. [1][9]

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with WAiNK. The launch roster holds 557 vehicles, and scanning alone counts — you never need to drive one. [1]
trophies.name: Whip It Good

steps.t: There are 557 vehicles at launch: cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes. [1]
Scan by holding Up for instant WAiNK, then R1; scan passing traffic on busy roads for the fastest count. [1]
Check the total under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles; scanning is enough, driving is not required. [1]

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. The window lasts only seconds, so set it up first: full focus bar, a packed target group, and Adrenaline to stretch the time. [1][9]
trophies.name: Gunslinger

steps.t: Trigger Combat Focus with L3 + R3 while aiming; it drains the purple focus bar at the top left. [1][9]
You need 5 takedowns inside one use, which lasts only a few seconds, so line up a packed group before you trigger it. [1]
Stretch the window with Adrenaline: hold L1, then press Triangle. [1]
Refill focus by eating or drinking, or by washing your face or showering at home; the Duke 556 assault rifle suits the job. [1]
Police, soldiers and civilians do not count, and each fish you catch adds about 10% to the focus meter if you need a top-up. [1]

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a big plane docked at a boarding bridge at VCIA and fly it 1 km. Planes parked out on the field do not count, and some lists call this a second possible miss. [1]
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

steps.t: Pick a big plane docked at a boarding bridge; planes parked on the field do not count. [1]
Climb up to it, get into the cockpit, reverse it onto the runway and take off; gates E3 and E4 are the easiest starts. [1]
Reach the plane by smashing through the airfield fence, or by walking in through the terminal; the stairs beside the boarding bridge lead straight to the plane door. [1]
Fly 1 km (0.6 miles) and the trophy pops. [1]

trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station and shoot enemies until the trophy pops. The base sits on an island south-west of the map. [1][7]
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

steps.t: Travel to Mile Zero Air Station, the island in the south-west of the map in Mariana County. [1][7]
Find the tank south of the base and get in through the gate, or by a stunt jump at the south-east entrance. [1]
Once inside the tank, shoot enemies until the trophy pops. [1]

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet with the Snap Gun, grab the safe code from the backroom, kill the alarm and the footage, and slip out. [1]
trophies.name: Sneakthief

steps.t: Wait until after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, then hit Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City. [1]
The Snap Gun sits permanently in your inventory with nothing to equip: use it for a stealth entry instead of kicking the door and tripping the alarm. [1]
Read the safe code note in the backroom, destroy the security footage and switch the alarm off there too. [1]
Leave quietly; the trophy pops shortly after you are out of the store. [1]

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. The vault jobs open with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is, and each vault pays up to $205,000. Note the grade: Silver, not Bronze as one guide misprints it. [1][7]
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

steps.t: Start the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe) and follow the security van until it stops at the bank. [1]
The guard carries the briefcase and the vault stands open; you cannot carry all the money alone, so bring a partner and hold Right to hand over one bag. [1]
Unlock the van tips first: pay Yasmani $10,000 after robbing 2 Payday Loans, which is the requirement for the tips. [1]
Robbing a vault means an instant 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast bike and swap vehicles once clear. [1]
Repeat for 5 of the 8 Large Bank Jobs in total; a single bank pays up to $205,000. [1]
The grade is Silver: the kit, Exophase, GTABase and OutputLag all agree, and the Bronze printed in one guide is an error. [7]

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easiest route is free: the vault robbery in the Chapter 4 mission already counts as one. [1]
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

steps.t: Play the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…: robbing its vault counts as robbing an armored truck, and the trophy unlocks automatically. [1]
Escape the red heat zone or duck into a Pay 'n' Spray to clear the wanted level. [1]
For an earlier shot, ambush an armored truck near a bank and stick a sticky bomb on its rear door; sticky bombs also sit behind Yasmani's shop after his quest. [1]

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: five counties from the Keys to Mount Kalaga National Park. The map fills in as you travel, so this finishes naturally on a thorough playthrough. [15][18]
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

steps.t: Cover the five counties: Mariana, Vice-Dale, Leonard, Kelly and Lummox. [15]
Sweep the named regions too: the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park. [15]
The game tracks the areas you have visited, so drive the map edges and the back roads rather than fast-travelling everywhere. [18]

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. Gang operations appear on the map as the story opens them up; clear one per gang and the trophy pops. [7][18]
trophies.name: Pest Control

steps.t: There are 9 gangs to cover, one illegal operation each. [7]
Watch the map for gang operation icons as the story progresses; they open up alongside the robbery systems. [7][18]
Rob the operation, escape clean, and repeat for the next gang until all nine are done. [1]

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The reported method is an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar — but a second source still calls the exact steps unconfirmed, so treat it as reported, not proven. [1][7]
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

steps.t: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach. [1]
Buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing beside the bar. [1]
If nothing pops, stop: GTABase still lists the exact steps as not confirmed, so the method is reported and awaiting a second confirmation. [7]

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in the blue Banshee. The reported method needs the Key Cloner from Chapter 3, and only that one blue Banshee counts. [1][7]
trophies.name: Capital Offense

steps.t: Get the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs first. [1]
Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom south of Vice City and smash out through the showroom window. [1]
If the pop is delayed, keep driving: the reported pop lags behind the smash, and GTABase still lists the steps as not confirmed. [1][7]

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Work the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn and grab its three items. The trophy pops after you escape the police, and the robbery icon respawns, so nothing here is missable. [1][7]
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

steps.t: Hit the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn. [1][7]

Grab the three items: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the north-east corner table, and the safe in the north-east corridor, opened with a sticky bomb. [1]
Escape the police and the trophy pops. [1]
Missed an item? Come back: the robbery icon respawns, and all three are not required in a single visit. [1][7]

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal: train at the gym with your partner. Buy a membership, work out together, and the trophy pops. [9]
trophies.name: Personal Best

steps.t: Buy a gym membership, then start a workout with your partner beside you. [9]
Your partner joins the training session; finish the workout together and the trophy pops. [9]

trophies.guide: Make 500 choices that change your Criminal Profile. Most players earn this without trying, but nobody has defined what counts as one action — so just play, keep the notifications on, and watch the count. [7][1]
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

steps.t: The count is 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile; most players earn it without trying. [7]
See the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list, and turn on Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile. [1]
A demon-face icon appears at the right of the screen each time an action registers. [1]
The tiers run Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable; Irredeemable is permanent, and the profile also changes how police react to you. [1][7]

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — and that is all anyone knows. No source has confirmed the trigger, so this guide labels it honestly instead of inventing a method. [1][7]
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

steps.t: The trigger is not known: PowerPyx guesses it relates to a Payday Loans shop in the Prologue, but that is a guess, not a confirmation. [1]
Until a source confirms a method, do not grind for this one; play normally and check back when a second source reports it. [1][7]

trophies.guide: Witness the UFO easter egg north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 02:00, alone. The method is reported by one source and still unconfirmed by another. [1][7]
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

steps.t: Go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 02:00; the spawn is somewhat random, so you may need more than one night. [1]
Look for a car flashing at the roadside, then follow the footpath into the woods to the UFO's bright blue light. [1]
Approach the UFO; it lowers the abducted woman. Talk to her and offer help. [1]
She asks to be taken back to her car at the roadside; do that and the trophy pops — but GTABase still lists the steps as not confirmed, so treat it as reported. [1][7]

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by. No source has confirmed the trigger, so this guide labels it honestly instead of inventing a method. [1][7]
trophies.name: Ten Pin

steps.t: The trigger is not known: PowerPyx guesses it comes from kicking someone while riding a motorbike. [1]
GTABase guesses instead that it comes from knocking someone down with a melee drive-by from a vehicle. Neither is confirmed. [7]

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through your fences. The Dye Pack Jammer from Credit Check is the key, and Yasmani in Vice City pays the best rate. [1]
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to get the Dye Pack Jammer. [1]
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then carry the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the highest rate. [1]
The total is $250,000 cumulative, and one bank vault alone pays up to $205,000 in a few minutes. [1]

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, car mods and tattoos burn money fastest, and Leonida is full of shops to spend it in. [1]
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

steps.t: Weapons, car mods and tattoos are the fastest ways to spend $100,000. [1]
The shop count is generous: 14 Mod Shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 Clothing Stores, 17 Footwear, 18 Hair & Beauty, 11 Tattoo Studios and 15 Electronics Stores. [1]
Spend across any of them; the total is cumulative and never resets. [1]

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages for $160,000 in total. They open after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone. [1]
trophies.name: Little Boxes

steps.t: Wait until after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses). [1]
Watch for the Vice City Real Estate app notification on your phone, then buy through the app. [1]
There are 8 purchasable garages plus 4 story garages, $160,000 in total. [1]

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Buy a garage first for the parking slots, then bring cheap stolen cars to Moses in Port Gellhorn — or any Pay 'n' Spray from Chapter 3. [1]
trophies.name: On the Spot

steps.t: The Scooter Bros app installs after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). [1]
Buy a garage first: each garage adds one parking slot or more, and registered vehicles can be delivered to you. [1]
Bring a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn and click Respray, then Register; at first Moses only takes vehicles without a tracker. [1]
From Chapter 3, register tracked cars at any Pay 'n' Spray instead; registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes. [1]
